thread.title: Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) CEO Tim Cook Talks About Market, “I’m a big believer in the free market”

author: Jim Breem
title: Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) CEO Tim Cook Talks About Market, “I’m a big believer in the free market”
text:
Locations November 19, 2018 Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) CEO Tim Cook Talks About Market, “I’m a big believer in the free market”
Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL)’s Chief Executive Tim Cook says that a series of regulation of tech companies is coming soon because the free market “is not working.
Tim Cook, Apple CEO said, “I’m a big believer in the free market. But we have to admit when the free market is not working. And it hasn’t worked here. I think it’s inevitable that there will be some level of regulation.”
Tim Cook further said that the tech companies should not be afraid of regulations, in a show airing Sunday night,
“Generally speaking, I am not a big fan of regulation,” Cook told Axios in an interview for “Axios on HBO,”, but “I think the Congress and the administration at some point will pass something”.
“This is not a matter of privacy versus profits, or privacy versus technical innovation. That’s a false choice,” he said.
Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL)’s Chief Executive told Axios that while he believes that the technology is not inherently good or bad, but the awareness should be there for companies and their products, that it can be misused.
Silicon Valley has also embraced diversity in general, Cook said, it has also missed it when it comes to reduce the gender gap. About Jim Breem
